documents.title: Demand Notice for Refund of Security Deposit
documents.body:
# LEGAL DEMAND NOTICE FOR REFUND OF SECURITY DEPOSIT

To,
Mr. Suresh Gowda
[LANDLORD ADDRESS IN KORAMangala, BANGALORE]

From:
[TENANT NAME]
[TENANT ADDRESS]
Phone: [PHONE NUMBER]

Date: November 7, 2026

Subject: Demand for immediate refund of security deposit amounting to ₹80,000 paid under the rental agreement.

Dear Sir,

1. That you and the undersigned entered into an 11-month rental agreement for the residential premises located in Koramangala, Bangalore.

2. That pursuant to the said agreement, the undersigned paid a security deposit of ₹80,000 (Rupees Eighty Thousand Only) via bank transfer on [DATE OF PAYMENT].

3. That the undersigned peacefully vacated and handed over vacant possession of the said premises to you on September 5, 2026.

4. That despite the peaceful surrender of the premises and completion of all obligations, you have wrongfully withheld the entire security deposit of ₹80,000 under the pretext of painting charges, without providing any supporting bills, receipts, or justification, and without issuing any receipt for the deposit.

5. Withholding the entire security deposit without lawful deduction or justification constitutes a breach of obligations under the law [[ICA1872:s73]].

6. Therefore, through this notice, you are called upon to refund the full security deposit amount of ₹80,000 to the undersigned's bank account within a short deadline from the receipt of this notice.

7. If you fail to refund the said amount within the stipulated time, the undersigned will be forced to take appropriate legal action under civil law to recover the same along with costs.

Sincerely,

[TENANT NAME]
